WITH fielding_by_hand AS (
  SELECT 
    p.bats,
    COUNT(f.player_id) as count
  FROM fielding f
  JOIN player p ON f.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.bats
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as num_hands,
    SUM(count) as total_count,
    CAST(SUM(count) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*) as avg_count
  FROM fielding_by_hand
)
SELECT 
  fbh.bats,
  fbh.count,
  CAST(fbh.count AS FLOAT) / s.total_count as share,
  fbh.count - s.avg_count as above_average
FROM fielding_by_hand fbh
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE fbh.count > s.avg_count
